modules.name: 1200 × 400 train turntable
modules.blurb: The whole 1172 mm deck turns end for end on a centre bearing to reverse a train. Fixed aprons at the ends carry the track to the joining faces; a pin locks the deck at 0° and 180°. The deck swings out over the sides while turning, so leave clear space beside the board.
modules.hardware: 150 mm (6 in) lazy-susan bearing, 8 mm thick; 6 mm pin, 60 mm long; joining hardware.
